description: What the Portuguese municipal master plan (PDM, Plano Diretor Municipal) allows at a point (WGS84 latitude, longitude) or on a plot polygon: municipality, land-use category from the official land-use map, whether it is buildable, floor-area index, maximum floors, regulation articles, RAN and REN reserves, applicable provisional planning norms, municipal notices requiring confirmation, their official sources, and a link to the full analysis on pdm.xyzbim.eu. Mainland Portugal and the Azores. Field values are in Portuguese. Each result carries its source attribution. With a plan key in the connector URL (?chave=), the full regulation fields (height, coverage, minimum plot area, uses, conditions) are returned and the plan quota is used. (PT: o que o PDM permite num ponto ou num terreno.)

lat.description: WGS84 latitude (e.g. 40.15); with lon, a 20 m x 20 m plot centred on the point

poligono.description: optional plot polygon instead of lat/lon: 3 to 500 [longitude, latitude] vertices (WGS84)

name: pdm_terreno
title: PDM rules at a point
